learning_outcomes.text: To know the main characteristics of the materials used in the structural field.
Knowledge of the main production processes of plastic, composite and ceramic materials.
Demonstrate ability to compare the characteristics of different materials in the structural field.
Demonstrate the ability to select a manufacturing process for a given component.
Demonstrate the ability to select a machining process appropriately given the material specifications and desired characteristics.
Demonstrate the ability to select the most appropriate joining process to match components of the same material and different materials given the Project specifications.

syllabus_topics: Chemical and physical characteristics of polymer components.
Main methods of characterization of polymeric materials.
Chemical and physical characteristics of composite components.
Main methods of characterization of composite materials.
Chemical and physical characteristics of ceramic components.
Main methods of characterization of ceramic materials.
Advanced processing: laser beam, electron beam, plasma arc, ultrasound, water jet, and surface treatments.
Thermal, chemical and mechanical joining processes.
teaching_methods: Interaction with students through problems and decision-making situations
Preparation of written reports (including group reports)

assessment_methods.method: Oral exam (three questions on main course content)

assessment_rules: The final exam consists of an oral test with three questions on the main contents of the course. This aims to ascertain the student's knowledge and understanding of the theoretical principles.
bibliography: J.A. Mc Geough, Advanced Methods of Machining, Chapman and Hall.

degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Industriale (Industrial Engineering), classe L-9 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria industriale
